content: उपज्ञा €9 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To ascertain; to know. .²2 To invent, find out, hit upon. (उपज्ञातम् = विनोपदेशेन ज्ञातम्); न पापमुपजानते <ls>Av. 4. 36. 8</ls>; see उपज्ञा below.

उपज्ञा [उपज्ञायते इत्युपज्ञा कर्मण्यङ्] .²1 Knowledge acquired by oneself and not handed down by tradition, invention, primitive or untaught knowledge; usually in <ab>comp.</ab> which is treated as a neuter noun (<ls>P. II. 4. 21</ls>); पाणिनेरुपज्ञा पाणिन्युपज्ञं ग्रन्थः <ls>Sk.</ls>; प्राचेतसोपज्ञं रामायणम् <ls>R. 15. 63</ls>. .²2 Undertaking or commencing a thing not done before; लोकेऽभूद्यदुपज्ञमेव विदुषां सौजन्यजन्यं यशः <ls>Malli.</ls> on Raghuvaṃśa.
